vb_textbox.text: I think the most important factor in determining the number of mushrooms found is the colour of the gnome's hat (rather than its shape). At certain times in the game, more vivid or intense colours seem to yield the largest number of mushrooms, and at other points less intense or duller ones.  Therefore, alternate between both types at the start to establish which colour of hat (vivid or dull) is delivering the largest number of mushrooms and stick with that in successive rounds.  Once the number begins to fall on a consistent basis, switch to the other type of colour (whether vivid or dull).  Keep repeating this process throughout the game, so if you find that intense hats are performing less well than was previously the case, start selecting dull ones from now on (until they eventually dip in performance), and so on.  I don't think the shape of hats (tall or flatter) had much of an effect but it could be that dullness or intensity COMBINED with shape could improve the score.  For example, there might be a scenario where intense AND tall hats result in a larger number of mushrooms being found than intense AND flatter hats, or vice versa.  Overall, though, my advice would be to make your selections based primarily on the intensity of the colour rather than the shape of the hats.
